provenance.note: Fictional company written for harness validation. Not a real company; any resemblance is coincidental.

evidence.text: Vantor Secure Analytics delivers video analytics for critical infrastructure sites. Deploy 100% on-premise: your footage never leaves your site.
All Vantor plans are hosted in the Vantor cloud. On-premise installation is not available at this time.
Vantor Secure Analytics is headquartered in Lyon, France.
Vantor Secure Analytics told us it is preparing an on-premises edition for 2027, aimed at customers in the energy sector.

onPrem.rationale: The pricing page says on-premise is not available and a third party reports an edition planned for 2027; the homepage claim conflicts with this.

hardware.rationale: Camera or server hardware is not described.

conflicts.description: The homepage promises 100% on-premise deployment, while the pricing page says all plans are cloud-hosted and on-premise is not available; a third-party report says an on-premises edition is only planned for 2027.

fit.rationale: An on-premises edition for energy customers would need exactly the kind of site appliance Northwind builds, but today Vantor appears to be cloud-hosted and its own pages contradict each other, so the fit depends on an edition that is only reported as planned.

supporting.statement: A planned on-premises edition targets the energy sector, a Northwind market.

opportunity.thesis: If the 2027 on-premises edition is real, offer a Northwind appliance as its standard delivery platform for energy-sector sites.
opportunity.ownBrings: On-premises AI inference appliances for energy sites.
opportunity.targetBrings: Video analytics for critical infrastructure and a reported on-premises roadmap.

confidence.rationale: The decisive fact, whether on-premise exists, is contradicted between official pages and only a third party describes the plan.

nextAction.text: Ask Vantor to clarify whether an on-premises edition exists today and its 2027 timeline before proposing an OEM appliance.
